from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the extracted legal information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as written")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case (e.g., '刑事', '行政', '民事')")
    specific_charges_or_causes: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific criminal charges or legal causes mentioned in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all case records extracted from the document."""
    case_records: list[CaseRecord]
